problem: Cloud Mac rental for iMessage/Beeper not working - activation fails or Beeper won't install
hint: iMessage on cloud Macs requires a DEDICATED server, not shared hosting. Apple blocks iMessage activation on shared/managed Mac instances. Also, Beeper requires macOS 12+ (Monterey). Common pitfall: cheap rentals use 2012 Mac minis stuck on Catalina (10.15) which can't run Beeper. Solution: Rent a dedicated Mac mini 2018+ with macOS 12+ minimum. MacinCloud dedicated: https://checkout.macincloud.com/select/dedicated. For full ai-os compatibility (Swift apps), need macOS 14+ (Sonoma).
